classResources.name: 狂暴
classResources.description: 作为附赠动作进入狂暴状态，获得伤害加成和物理伤害抗性。
classResources.descriptionEn: Enter a battle rage as a bonus action, gaining damage bonus and resistance to physical damage.

classResources.name: 激励骰
classResources.description: 用附赠动作给予60尺内一个生物激励骰，可用于攻击、属性检定或豁免。
classResources.descriptionEn: Grant a creature within 60 feet an inspiration die to add to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

classResources.name: 引导神力
classResources.description: 引导神力来产生魔法效果，具体效果取决于领域。
classResources.descriptionEn: Channel divine energy to fuel magical effects determined by your domain.

classResources.name: 野性形态
classResources.description: 用动作变形为你见过的野兽。
classResources.descriptionEn: Magically assume the shape of a beast you have seen before.

classResources.name: 回气
classResources.description: 用附赠动作恢复1d10+战士等级的生命值。
classResources.descriptionEn: Regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points as a bonus action.

classResources.name: 行动如潮
classResources.description: 在本回合获得一个额外动作。
classResources.descriptionEn: Take one additional action on your turn.

classResources.name: 战技骰
classResources.description: 用战技骰执行特殊战技，增强攻击效果。
classResources.descriptionEn: Fuel special maneuvers that enhance your attacks.

classResources.name: 气
classResources.description: 掌控生命能量之流，用于激活各种武僧能力。
classResources.descriptionEn: Harness the mystic energy of ki to fuel various monk abilities.

classResources.name: 神圣感知
classResources.description: 感知60尺内的天界、邪魔、不死生物以及被祝圣或亵渎之处。
classResources.descriptionEn: Sense celestials, fiends, undead, and consecrated/desecrated places within 60 feet.

classResources.name: 圣疗
classResources.description: 触摸生物恢复生命值，或花费5点治疗一种疾病或中和一种毒素。
classResources.descriptionEn: Heal creatures by touch or cure diseases/neutralize poisons.

classResources.name: 神击
classResources.description: 近战武器命中时消耗法术位造成额外光耀伤害。2d8(1环)，每高一环+1d8(最多5d8)，对不死生物或邪魔额外+1d8。
classResources.descriptionEn: Expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage on a melee weapon hit.

classResources.name: 引导神力
classResources.description: 引导神力来产生魔法效果，具体效果取决于誓约。
classResources.descriptionEn: Channel divine energy to fuel magical effects determined by your oath.

classResources.name: 神圣惩击
classResources.description: 命中时消耗法术位造成额外光耀伤害。
classResources.descriptionEn: Expend spell slots to deal extra radiant damage on a hit.

classResources.name: 原始意识
classResources.description: 花费一个法术位来感知1英里内(偏好地形中为6英里)的异界生物、龙、元素、妖精、邪魔或不死生物的存在。
classResources.descriptionEn: Expend a spell slot to sense the presence of aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 1 mile (6 miles in favored terrain).

classResources.name: 术法点
classResources.description: 用于激活超魔技能或转换法术位。
classResources.descriptionEn: Fuel metamagic options or convert to/from spell slots.

classResources.name: 奥术恢复
classResources.description: 短休时恢复总等级不超过法师等级一半的法术位。
classResources.descriptionEn: Recover spell slots with total level up to half wizard level on short rest.

classResources.name: 预言
classResources.description: 长休后投2个d20，可用这些结果替代任何你能看到的生物的攻击检定、豁免或属性检定。
classResources.descriptionEn: Roll 2d20 after a long rest; use these rolls to replace any attack, save, or check you can see.

classResources.name: 奥术守御
classResources.description: 施放防护系法术时创建魔法护盾，吸收伤害。
classResources.descriptionEn: Create a magical ward when casting abjuration spells that absorbs damage.

classResources.name: 混乱之潮
classResources.description: 在攻击检定、属性检定或豁免前获得优势。之后DM可让你在施法时触发狂野魔法浪涌来恢复此能力。
classResources.descriptionEn: Gain advantage on one attack, check, or save. DM can have you roll on Wild Magic Surge to regain this.

classResources.name: 暗影技艺
classResources.description: 获得次级幻术戏法。此外可花费2气施放：黑暗术、黑暗视觉、通行无阻或沉默术（无需材料成分）。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence.

classResources.name: 元素戒律
classResources.description: 花费气点施放元素法术或增强攻击。3级选2个法门（含必选的元素调谐），6/11/17级各+1个，可替换已有法门。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend ki to cast elemental spells or enhance attacks. Choose 2 at 3rd (including Elemental Attunement), +1 at 6th/11th/17th, may replace one each time.

classResources.name: 开手技巧
classResources.description: 疾风连击命中时可对目标施加以下效果之一：击倒（敏捷豁免）、推开至多15尺（力量豁免）、或封锁反应直到你下回合结束。
classResources.descriptionEn: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, impose additional effects on the target.

classResources.name: 完整自我
classResources.description: 用一个动作恢复等于武僧等级×3的生命值。每次长休后可使用一次。
classResources.descriptionEn: As an action, regain HP equal to three times your monk level. Once per long rest.

classResources.name: 宁静
classResources.description: 每次长休结束时进入特殊冥想，获得圣域术效果，持续到下次长休开始（法术可按正常规则提前结束）。DC = 8 + 感知调整值 + 熟练加值。
classResources.descriptionEn: At the end of a long rest, gain the effect of a Sanctuary spell until the start of your next long rest. DC = 8 + Wis mod + proficiency.

classResources.name: 颤栗掌
classResources.description: 徒手攻击命中时花费3气在目标体内设置震颤（同时限一个目标，持续武僧等级天数）。须同一位面，可用动作结束：体质豁免，失败降至0HP，成功受10d10黑蚀伤害。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend 3 ki when you hit a creature to set imperceptible vibrations. Use action to end: target makes Con save, fail = 0 HP, success = 10d10 necrotic.

classResources.name: 暗影步
classResources.description: 在暗光或黑暗中，用附赠动作传送到60尺内你能看到的另一个暗光或黑暗区域。传送后该回合第一次近战攻击检定具有优势。
classResources.descriptionEn: In dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 ft to another dim/dark area as bonus action. First melee attack after has advantage.

classResources.name: 暗影斗篷
classResources.description: 在暗光或黑暗中，用一个动作变为隐形。持续到你进行攻击、施放法术或进入明亮光照区域。
classResources.descriptionEn: In dim light or darkness, use action to become invisible. Lasts until you attack, cast a spell, or are in bright light.

classResources.name: 机会主义者
classResources.description: 非你的回合中，当5尺内的生物被你以外的攻击命中时，可以用反应对其进行一次近战攻击。
classResources.descriptionEn: When a creature within 5 ft is hit by an attack from someone other than you, use reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

classResources.name: 自然恢复
classResources.description: 短休时恢复总等级不超过德鲁伊等级一半的法术位。
classResources.descriptionEn: Recover spell slots with total level up to half druid level on short rest.

classResources.name: 战斗野性形态
classResources.description: 可以用附赠动作使用野性形态，变形时可消耗法术位治疗。
classResources.descriptionEn: Use Wild Shape as bonus action; spend spell slots to heal while transformed.

classResources.name: 偷袭
classResources.description: 每回合一次，对有优势或有盟友邻接的目标造成额外伤害。
classResources.descriptionEn: Once per turn, deal extra damage to a target you have advantage against or that has an ally adjacent.

classResources.name: 灵巧动作
classResources.description: 每回合可用附赠动作执行疾走、撤离或躲藏。
classResources.descriptionEn: Use bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide each turn.

classResources.name: 刺杀
classResources.description: 对措手不及的目标攻击具有优势，命中即为重击。
classResources.descriptionEn: Advantage against creatures that haven't acted; hits against surprised creatures are critical.

classResources.name: 精湛重击
classResources.description: 攻击检定投出19-20即视为重击。
classResources.descriptionEn: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.

classResources.name: 不屈
classResources.description: 重掷一次失败的豁免检定，必须使用新结果。
classResources.descriptionEn: Reroll a failed saving throw. You must use the new roll.

classResources.name: 净化之触
classResources.description: 用动作结束自己或碰触生物身上的一个法术。
classResources.descriptionEn: End one spell on yourself or one willing creature that you touch.

classResources.name: 神圣干预
classResources.description: 恳求神祇介入，掷百分骰≤牧师等级即成功。20级自动成功。
classResources.descriptionEn: Implore your deity to intervene. Roll percentile dice; success if result ≤ cleric level.

classResources.name: 好运当头
classResources.description: 将未命中的攻击变为命中，或将失败的属性检定视为掷出20。
classResources.descriptionEn: Turn a missed attack into a hit, or treat a failed ability check as rolling a 20.

classResources.name: 秘法奥秘
classResources.description: 每次长休可各施放一次6~9环奥秘法术。
classResources.descriptionEn: Cast each arcanum spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

classResources.name: 魔能大师
classResources.description: 花费1分钟恳求恩主恢复所有已使用的契约魔法法术位。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend 1 minute entreating your patron to regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots.

classResources.name: 妖精存在
classResources.description: 用动作令10尺内生物进行感知豁免，失败则被魅惑或恐惧。
classResources.descriptionEn: Each creature in a 10-foot cube must make a Wisdom save or be charmed or frightened.

classResources.name: 招牌法术
classResources.description: 两个3环法术各施放一次而不消耗法术位。短休后恢复。
classResources.descriptionEn: Cast two chosen 3rd-level spells once each without expending a spell slot.

classResources.name: 护卫闪光
classResources.description: 被攻击时用反应令攻击者的攻击检定具有劣势。
classResources.descriptionEn: When attacked, use reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

classResources.name: 风暴之怒
classResources.description: 被近战击中时用反应令攻击者进行敏捷豁免，失败受2d8雷鸣/闪电伤害。
classResources.descriptionEn: When hit by a melee attack, use reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (Dex save for half).

classResources.name: 战争祭司
classResources.description: 攻击动作后用附赠动作进行一次武器攻击。
classResources.descriptionEn: When you use the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

classResources.name: 命运窃贼
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展灾祸术(bane)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 心灵泥沼
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展缓慢术(slow)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 凶兆符记
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展降咒(bestow curse)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 惑人低语
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展强迫术(compulsion)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 恐惧箴言
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展困惑术(confusion)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 重塑血肉
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展变形术(polymorph)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 混沌手下
classResources.description: 消耗邪术师法术位施展召唤元素生物(conjure elemental)。每次长休可使用一次。

classResources.name: 幸运点
classResources.description: 你可以花费一个幸运点来额外投一颗d20，用于攻击检定、属性检定或豁免检定，选择使用哪个结果。也可以在攻击你的投骰上使用。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend a luck point to roll an additional d20 for attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws, choosing which to use.

classResources.name: 魔法学徒法术
classResources.description: 你可以施展通过魔法学徒专长学会的1环法术，每天一次，无需消耗法术位。
classResources.descriptionEn: Cast the 1st-level spell learned through Magic Initiate once per day without expending a spell slot.

classResources.name: 优势骰
classResources.description: 你获得一个d6优势骰，可用于你通过武艺专家专长学会的战技。
classResources.descriptionEn: You gain one d6 superiority die to fuel maneuvers learned through Martial Adept.

classResources.name: 治疗师救治
classResources.description: 使用治疗包为一个生物恢复 1d6+4+该生物HD数量 的HP。注意：每个生物在每次短休之间只能受益一次。
classResources.descriptionEn: Use a healer's kit to restore 1d6+4+creature's HD in HP. Note: each creature can only benefit once per short rest.

classResources.name: 鼓舞演说
classResources.description: 花费10分钟鼓舞最多6名友方生物（可包含自己），每个受鼓舞的生物获得等于你的等级+魅力修正的临时生命值。注意：每个生物在每次短休之间只能受益一次。
classResources.descriptionEn: Spend 10 minutes to inspire up to 6 friendly creatures, each gaining temp HP equal to your level + CHA modifier. Note: each creature can only benefit once per short rest.

resourceAbilities.name: 狂暴
resourceAbilities.description: 用附赠动作进入狂暴，获得近战伤害加值与钝击/穿刺/挥砍抗性。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Enter a rage as a bonus action, gaining melee damage bonus and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

resourceAbilities.name: 野性形态
resourceAbilities.description: 用动作变形为你见过的野兽。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Use an action to transform into a beast you have seen.

resourceAbilities.name: 战斗野性形态
resourceAbilities.description: 月亮结社可以用附赠动作使用野性形态，并共享野性形态次数。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Circle of the Moon can use Wild Shape as a bonus action, sharing the same Wild Shape uses.

resourceAbilities.name: 回气
resourceAbilities.description: 用附赠动作恢复1d10+战士等级生命值。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points as a bonus action.

resourceAbilities.name: 行动如潮
resourceAbilities.description: 在你的回合额外获得一个动作。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Gain one additional action on your turn.

resourceAbilities.name: 神圣感知
resourceAbilities.description: 用动作感知附近的天界生物、邪魔、不死生物与被祝圣或亵渎之地。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Use an action to sense nearby celestials, fiends, undead, and consecrated or desecrated places.

resourceAbilities.name: 自然恢复
resourceAbilities.description: 短休时恢复总等级不超过德鲁伊等级一半的法术位。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to half your druid level during a short rest.

resourceAbilities.name: 奥术恢复
resourceAbilities.description: 短休时恢复总等级不超过法师等级一半的法术位。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to half your wizard level during a short rest.

resourceAbilities.name: 疾行拳
resourceAbilities.description: 攻击后用附赠动作进行两次徒手攻击。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: After taking the Attack action, make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

resourceAbilities.name: 患者防御
resourceAbilities.description: 用附赠动作执行躲避动作。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

resourceAbilities.name: 疾步
resourceAbilities.description: 用附赠动作执行疾走或撤离动作，跳跃距离加倍。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action; jump distance doubled.

resourceAbilities.name: 震慑打击
resourceAbilities.description: 近战命中时尝试震慑目标（体质豁免）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When you hit with a melee attack, attempt to stun the target (Con save).

resourceAbilities.name: 空灵体
resourceAbilities.description: 隐形1分钟并获得所有伤害抗性（力场除外）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Become invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage except force.

resourceAbilities.name: 元素调谐
resourceAbilities.description: 你可以用动作产生微弱的元素效果：制造无害的感官效果（如火花、微风、水雾、泥土气味）；点燃或熄灭一根蜡烛、火把或小型篝火；冷却或加热至多1磅无生命物质持续1小时；使土、火、水或气元素在1尺立方内塑形持续1分钟。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Use action for minor elemental effects: harmless sensory effect, light/snuff a candle or small campfire, chill/warm 1 lb of material for 1 hour, shape earth/fire/water/mist in a 1-foot cube for 1 minute.

resourceAbilities.name: 火蛇之牙
resourceAbilities.description: 在你回合中攻击动作时花费1点气，你的徒手攻击触及范围在该回合增加10尺。命中时造成火焰伤害而非钝击伤害，且若你额外花费1点气，还可造成额外1d10火焰伤害。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 1 ki when you take the Attack action. Unarmed strike reach increases by 10 feet for the turn, dealing fire damage. Spend 1 additional ki for +1d10 fire damage on hit.

resourceAbilities.name: 四雷之拳
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放雷鸣波（Thunderwave）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Thunderwave.

resourceAbilities.name: 裂空之拳
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气创造压缩空气冲击波。30尺内一个生物须进行力量豁免，失败受3d10钝击伤害并被推开最多20尺且被击倒；成功则伤害减半且不被推开或击倒。每额外花费1点气（最多3点），伤害增加1d10。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki. One creature within 30 ft makes Str save: fail takes 3d10 bludgeoning, pushed up to 20 ft, knocked prone; success takes half, no push/prone. +1d10 per extra ki (max 3).

resourceAbilities.name: 疾风之灵
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放阵风术（Gust of Wind）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Gust of Wind.

resourceAbilities.name: 塑造流水
resourceAbilities.description: 用动作操控120尺内30尺见方区域的水或冰。你可以将水变为冰或冰变为水，改变水流方向，或将冰塑造成简单形状。同一区域每次最多操控一次。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Use action to control water/ice in a 30-ft cube within 120 ft. Convert water to ice or vice versa, redirect water flow, or reshape ice into simple forms.

resourceAbilities.name: 扫灭余烬
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放燃烧之手（Burning Hands）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Burning Hands.

resourceAbilities.name: 水鞭
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气用动作创造水鞭。30尺内一个生物须进行敏捷豁免，失败受3d10钝击伤害并可被拉近最多25尺或击倒；成功则伤害减半且不被拉近或击倒。每额外花费1点气（最多3点），伤害增加1d10。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki. One creature within 30 ft makes Dex save: fail takes 3d10 bludgeoning, pulled up to 25 ft closer or knocked prone; success takes half, no pull/prone. +1d10 per extra ki (max 3).

resourceAbilities.name: 北风之握
resourceAbilities.description: 花费3点气施放人类定身术（Hold Person）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 3 ki to cast Hold Person.

resourceAbilities.name: 山巅之钟
resourceAbilities.description: 花费3点气施放碎裂术（Shatter）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 3 ki to cast Shatter.

resourceAbilities.name: 凤凰之焰
resourceAbilities.description: 花费4点气施放火球术（Fireball）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 4 ki to cast Fireball.

resourceAbilities.name: 雾隐身形
resourceAbilities.description: 花费4点气对自己施放气化形体（Gaseous Form）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 4 ki to cast Gaseous Form on yourself.

resourceAbilities.name: 御风而行
resourceAbilities.description: 花费4点气对自己施放飞行术（Fly）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 4 ki to cast Fly on yourself.

resourceAbilities.name: 永恒山岳防御
resourceAbilities.description: 花费5点气对自己施放石肤术（Stoneskin），无需材料成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 5 ki to cast Stoneskin on yourself without material components.

resourceAbilities.name: 饥饿火焰之河
resourceAbilities.description: 花费5点气施放火焰墙（Wall of Fire）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 5 ki to cast Wall of Fire.

resourceAbilities.name: 凛冬之息
resourceAbilities.description: 花费6点气施放寒冰锥（Cone of Cold）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 6 ki to cast Cone of Cold.

resourceAbilities.name: 滚地波涛
resourceAbilities.description: 花费6点气施放石墙术（Wall of Stone）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 6 ki to cast Wall of Stone.

resourceAbilities.name: 开手技巧：推开
resourceAbilities.description: 疾风连击命中时，目标进行力量豁免（DC = 气豁免DC），失败则被推开至多15尺。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, target must make Dex save or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

resourceAbilities.name: 开手技巧：击倒
resourceAbilities.description: 疾风连击命中时，目标进行敏捷豁免（DC = 气豁免DC），失败则被击倒（倒地状态）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, target must make Dex save or be knocked prone.

resourceAbilities.name: 开手技巧：封反应
resourceAbilities.description: 疾风连击命中时，目标无法进行反应直到你的下一回合结束。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When you hit with Flurry of Blows, target can't take reactions until end of your next turn.

resourceAbilities.name: 完整自我
resourceAbilities.description: 用一个动作恢复等于武僧等级×3的生命值。每次长休后可使用一次。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: As an action, regain HP equal to three times your monk level. Once per long rest.

resourceAbilities.name: 宁静
resourceAbilities.description: 每次长休结束时进入特殊冥想，获得圣域术效果，持续到下次长休开始（法术可按正常规则提前结束）。攻击你的生物须进行感知豁免（DC = 8 + 感知调整值 + 熟练加值），失败则必须选择其他目标。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: At end of long rest, gain Sanctuary effect until next long rest. Attackers must make Wis save (DC 8 + Wis mod + prof) or choose new target.

resourceAbilities.name: 颤栗掌
resourceAbilities.description: 徒手攻击命中时花费3气，在目标体内设置不可察觉的震颤（同时限一个目标，持续武僧等级天数）。你与目标须在同一位面时可用动作结束：目标体质豁免（DC = 气豁免DC），失败降至0HP，成功受10d10黑蚀伤害。也可无害地结束震颤。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 3 ki on hit to set vibrations. Use action to end: Con save, fail = 0 HP, success = 10d10 necrotic. One creature at a time.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影术：黑暗术
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放黑暗术（Darkness），无需材料成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Darkness without material components.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影术：黑暗视觉
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放黑暗视觉（Darkvision），无需材料成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Darkvision without material components.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影术：通行无阻
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放通行无阻（Pass Without Trace），无需材料成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Pass Without Trace without material components.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影术：沉默术
resourceAbilities.description: 花费2点气施放沉默术（Silence），无需材料成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Spend 2 ki to cast Silence without material components.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影步
resourceAbilities.description: 在暗光或黑暗中，用附赠动作传送到60尺内你能看到的另一个暗光或黑暗区域。传送后该回合第一次近战攻击检定具有优势。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: In dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 ft to another dim/dark area as bonus action. First melee attack after has advantage.

resourceAbilities.name: 暗影斗篷
resourceAbilities.description: 在暗光或黑暗中，用一个动作变为隐形。持续到你进行攻击、施放法术或进入明亮光照区域。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: In dim light or darkness, use action to become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or are in bright light.

resourceAbilities.name: 机会主义者
resourceAbilities.description: 非你的回合中，当5尺内的生物被你以外的攻击命中时，可以用反应对其进行一次近战攻击。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When a creature within 5 ft is hit by someone other than you, use reaction to make a melee attack.

resourceAbilities.name: 绊摔攻击
resourceAbilities.description: 命中时加战技骰伤害，大型或更小目标需力量豁免否则倒地。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Add superiority die to damage; Large or smaller target must make Str save or be knocked prone.

resourceAbilities.name: 回刺
resourceAbilities.description: 敌人近战攻击未中时用反应进行一次近战攻击，加战技骰伤害。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When a creature misses you with melee attack, use reaction to attack and add superiority die to damage.

resourceAbilities.name: 威慑攻击
resourceAbilities.description: 命中时加战技骰伤害，目标需感知豁免否则恐惧至你的下一回合结束。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Add superiority die to damage; target must make Wis save or be frightened until end of your next turn.

resourceAbilities.name: 精准攻击
resourceAbilities.description: 攻击检定加战技骰。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Add superiority die to the attack roll.

resourceAbilities.name: 招架
resourceAbilities.description: 被近战攻击命中时减少伤害（战技骰+敏捷调整值）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When hit by melee attack, reduce damage by superiority die + Dex modifier.

resourceAbilities.name: 孪生法术
resourceAbilities.description: 单目标法术影响第二个目标（消耗术法点等于法术环位）。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: When casting a single-target spell, target a second creature (cost = spell level, min 1).

resourceAbilities.name: 瞬发法术
resourceAbilities.description: 施法时间1动作的法术改为附赠动作。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Cast a spell with casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.

resourceAbilities.name: 微妙法术
resourceAbilities.description: 施法时不需要言语或姿势成分。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Cast a spell without verbal or somatic components.

resourceAbilities.name: 原始意识
resourceAbilities.description: 花费一个法术位感知1英里内(偏好地形中为6英里)的特定类型生物。
resourceAbilities.descriptionEn: Expend a spell slot to sense specific creature types within 1 mile (6 miles in favored terrain).
